qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom and Forge from a clean checkout of this commit; 266 Cubature tests per loader, 76 Cleanroom and 74 Forge lab tests, 0 failures (the lab's Cleanroom tests reported up to date). The four JARs are byte-identical to the 88baddb0 build, which on fresh Riven worlds passed a PREFETCH flight-and-settle (13,921 unloads and no loads while standing, the 20,538-cube floor), saved blocks of 82,215 cubes away from spawn matching a 9e45a6fa world, the lab generation and maintenance contracts, and a BASELINE route whose GC sweep ran at the 201st call; commits after 88baddb0 change only the lab's Python tools. riven.ps1 ci was not run with this pin.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing, a provider and lighting that reach the player cube map only through CubeDemand and SurfaceHeightListener, held teleports kept when a teleport leaves the player in place, and PlayerCubeMap, CubeProviderServer and the lab's Python tools split into focused parts (DeferredArrivals, CubeSender, PeriodicAutosave, ChunkGc's incremental GC; lab_profiles, lab_files, lab_process and lab_instance).
limits: Respawn, portal and join arrivals still load their column synchronously
